Taken on the credits that attract TDS under s.194C(5) and its proviso (as read here, pending the CA's confirmation of that reading): a credit over the single-sum limit from its own date; once the year's aggregate exceeds the aggregate limit, every credit, the earlier ones from the date the aggregate is crossed. The aggregate is gross and a crossing is never undone: a reversal lowers nothing. One the client's list classifies as reversing a particular bill, or as an error, is named on the payee's finding but not applied, pending bill-wise detail from the books. At the lower of the section's two rates (the payee's type is not known).
